_Generated 2026-08-06 by /mol:map._

## Inventory (monorepo)

Workspace root `molvis-plugins-official`; npm workspaces = `plugins/*`; the root
is a private meta package (`@molcrafts/molvis-plugins-official`), not a member
of its own workspace list.

### Module list

**Root meta — `@molcrafts/molvis-plugins-official` (v0.5.0, private)**
- `src/index.tsx` — meta plugin module; activates all four children in fixed order
- `src/version.ts` — meta id/version + `OFFICIAL_PLUGINS` roster (plain semver)
- `rsbuild.plugin-shared.ts` — one build recipe for every package (externals, dedupe, kernel asset copy)
- `rsbuild.config.ts` — collection build (`injectStyles`, `kernelRuntime`)
- `tsconfig.base.json` — strict ES2024 bundler config + `@molcrafts/molvis-core/molrs` path shim
- No `scripts/`. Guards are `package.json` one-liners (`check:manifests`,
  `check:official-plugins`, `verify:bundle`) wired into CI and pre-commit;
  release packaging is inline shell in `.github/workflows/release.yml`.
- `molvis.plugin.json` — host manifest (`com.molcrafts.plugins-official`)

**`plugins/alchemist` — `@molcrafts/molvis-plugin-alchemist` (v0.2.0)**
- `src/index.tsx` — plugin module: host dialog + toolbar command, drag handling
- `src/AlchemistGame.ts` — canvas game engine (`mountAlchemist`)
- `src/physics.ts` — `ChamberPhysics` (sleeping stacks, one impulse pass per tick)
- `src/model.ts` — pure game rules (spawn distribution, merge score, danger timer, tools)
- `src/elements.ts` — element table + radius lookup; `src/audio.ts` — `AlchemistAudio`
- `src/storage.ts` — `StorageAdapter` / `NamespacedLocalStorage` / progress load-save
- `src/site.ts` — standalone static-site entry (non-plugin); `src/alchemist.css`
- colocated `src/*.test.ts` (rstest, node env)
- own build pair (`rsbuild.config.ts` + `rslib.config.ts` + `rspack.shared.ts`) — **not** the shared recipe

**`plugins/carbon-tube-builder` — `…-carbon-tube-builder` (v0.1.2)**
- `src/index.tsx` — everything: `CarbonTubePanel` React form, Edit-mode panel registration, plugin module
- `src/version.ts`, `src/styles.css`, `src/styles.d.ts`
- no tests (`rstest run --passWithNoTests`)

**`plugins/lammps-input-generator` — `…-lammps-input-generator` (v0.1.2)**
- `src/index.tsx` — registration + cache entry + `generate` RPC
- `src/model/` — `types.ts`, `defaults.ts`, `schedule.ts` (temp points → stages), `unit_systems.ts`, `ff_presets.ts`
- `src/generate/generate.ts` — pure `LammpsEqConfig` → script text
- `src/commands/open-wizard/register.tsx`, `src/settings/about/register.tsx`
- `src/ui/` — `WizardDialog.tsx`, `steps/`, `sections/`, `Select.tsx`, `TempScheduleChart.tsx` (molplot), `styles.ts`
- `tests/` — 5 unit tests over generate / schedule / unit systems

**`plugins/pyodide-molpy` — `…-pyodide-molpy` (v0.2.0)**
- `src/index.tsx` — mode + panels + dialog + commands + caches + 2 RPC methods
- `src/kernel/` — `host_kernel.ts` (`HostKernel`, `MolvisPyodideKernel`, `getKernel()` singleton),
  `bootstrap.ts`, `display.ts`, `errors.ts`, `memory_contents.ts`, `runtime_assets.ts`,
  `types.ts`, `index.ts` (barrel), `generated_py.ts` (generated by `pack:py`), `pypi_urls_stub.js`
- `src/rpc/` — `client.ts` (in-page JSON-RPC over host `RPCRouter`), `envelope.ts`
- `src/model/` — `notebook.ts`, `cells.ts`, `ipynb.ts`, `scripts.ts`, `editor_settings.ts`
- `src/ui/` — `NotebookPanel.tsx`, `ConsolePanel.tsx`, `ScriptDialog.tsx`, `MonacoCellEditor.tsx`,
  `ShikiCodeView.tsx`, `console_sink.ts`, `theme.ts`, `hooks/useKernel.ts`
- `src/py/` — `rpc_bridge.py` (worker↔host postMessage, imports no molvis), `molvis_setup.py`
- `src/modes/python-mode.ts`, `src/cdn.ts`, `src/notebooks/*.ipynb`, `src/settings/{about,editor}/register.tsx`
- `tests/` (TS) + `tests/py/` (pytest). molpy/molvis are pinned PyPI packages in `src/cdn.ts` (`molcrafts-molvis==0.2.0`). Optional `pack-molvis-src.mjs` / `pack-molvis-wheel.mjs` overlay a sibling checkout or download the PyPI wheel as Release fallback.

### Public surface

- **root meta** — default `MolvisPluginModule` `{ id: "com.molcrafts.plugins-official", activate, deactivate }`;
  named `PLUGIN_ID`, `PLUGIN_VERSION`, `OFFICIAL_PLUGINS`, `OfficialPluginId`. `activate` calls
  `registerLammpsEqInput`, `registerCarbonTubeBuilder`, `alchemistPlugin.activate`,
  `registerPyodideMolpy` — unconditionally, by design. `rsbuild.plugin-shared.ts` exports
  `createPluginRsbuildConfig`, `pluginExternals`, `jupyterLiteRuntimeCopyPatterns`,
  `localMolpyWheelCopyPatterns`.
- **alchemist** — default plugin module only; **no `registerAlchemist` named export**, unlike the
  other three. Registers dialog `game` and command `open` (toolbar `alchemist-open`, order 80).
  Exports `mountAlchemist`, `AlchemistHandle`, model/storage/elements for its tests and `site.ts`.
- **carbon-tube-builder** — `registerCarbonTubeBuilder(api)` + default module; one Edit-mode tools
  panel `carbon-tube-builder` ("Carbon tube", order 100). No commands, no RPC.
- **lammps-input-generator** — `registerLammpsEqInput(api)` + default module; cache `draft`,
  dialog `wizard`, command `open-wizard` (toolbar order 40), settings "about", RPC `generate`
  (`{config} → {script}`). Storage key `lammps-input-config-v3` (`…-v2` legacy migration).
- **pyodide-molpy** — `registerPyodideMolpy(api)` + default module; mode `python` (tab order 50,
  panel `notebook`), bottom panel `console`, dialog `script`, commands `open-script`,
  `open-notebook`, `ipython-demo`, caches `notebook`/`scripts`/`editor-settings`, settings
  editor + about, RPC `kernelStatus` and `runScript`. Python side exposes `run_script`,
  `list_scripts`, `stage` into notebook globals; kernel barrel exports `HostKernel`, `getKernel`,
  `_resetKernelSingleton`, `isInterruptError`.

### Style summary

- **root meta** — `PLUGIN_ID`/`PLUGIN_VERSION` constants + `register*(api)` calls; one object
  literal implementing `MolvisPluginModule`; nothing caught (a child that throws reaches the host
  loader); no state. Build helpers are module-level functions with defensive `fs.existsSync` skips.
- **alchemist** — PascalCase classes/components, `mountAlchemist` returning a handle; `new
  AlchemistAudio()` / `new NamespacedLocalStorage()`; thrown `Error` in `site.ts` only; engine-owned
  mutable canvas state, progress in namespaced localStorage; model + storage pure and unit-tested.
- **carbon-tube-builder** — component + `register*`; `new CarbonTubeBuilder(n, m)` with `set*`
  then `.build()` and explicit `.free()`; try/catch → `setFailed`/`setMessage` with `aria-live`;
  React `useState` per field. Reads `app.mode` through a structural `getEditMode` guard and assigns
  `editMode.pendingMolecule` — an untyped host-internal seam cast through `unknown`.
- **lammps-input-generator** — `default*()` / `next*()` / `register*()` free functions over plain
  interfaces, no classes; `normalizeConfig(raw): … | null` (null-on-bad-input, not throws); React
  state in `WizardDialog` persisted to `api.storage` under a versioned key. Styling is an inline
  `css` object built from the SDK's `token()` — plugins have no Tailwind.
- **pyodide-molpy** — classes for stateful runtime (`HostKernel`, `MemoryContentsManager`,
  `ConsoleSinkLedger`, `IpynbError`), free functions for pure transforms and host registration;
  mostly `new`, but `getKernel()` is a **module-level singleton** and `createRpcClient(app)` /
  `createPythonMode(id)` are factory-style; typed `RpcError` wrapping in `client.ts`; kernel
  singleton + localStorage-backed state. The Python bridge deliberately imports no molvis/molpy so
  `tests/py/` can fake `js`.

### Layer roles

- **root** — `src/index.tsx` Entry; `src/version.ts` Host contract; `rsbuild*.ts`,
  `tsconfig.base.json` Build.
- **alchemist** — `index.tsx` Entry; `site.ts` Entry (second, standalone); `model.ts`,
  `storage.ts`, `elements.ts`, `physics.ts` Model; `AlchemistGame.ts`, `audio.ts` UI/runtime
  (imperative canvas, not React); `version.ts` Host contract.
- **carbon-tube-builder** — `index.tsx` is Entry **and** UI **and** host-contract probe in one
  file; no Model layer (geometry lives in molrs).
- **lammps-input-generator** — `index.tsx` Entry; `model/*`, `generate/generate.ts` Model
  (unit-tested); `ui/**` UI; `commands/*/register.tsx`, `settings/*/register.tsx`, `version.ts`
  Host contract.
- **pyodide-molpy** — `index.tsx` Entry; `model/*`, `rpc/envelope.ts`, `kernel/{display,errors,
  memory_contents}.ts`, `ui/console_sink.ts`, `py/rpc_bridge.py` Model (unit-tested);
  `kernel/host_kernel.ts`, `kernel/runtime_assets.ts`, `rpc/client.ts`, `modes/python-mode.ts`
  Host contract; `ui/**` UI; `cdn.ts`, generated files Build.

### Cross-cutting

- **Shared build recipe** — root, carbon-tube-builder, lammps-input-generator and pyodide-molpy
  call `createPluginRsbuildConfig({...})` (lammps passes no options, so `injectStyles` stays off —
  it styles through the inline `css` object). **alchemist opts out**: its own `rsbuild.config.ts`
  (static site, hashed filenames) plus `rslib.config.ts` for `dist/plugin.js`, sharing only
  `pluginExternals` and a local `rspack.shared.ts`.
- **`resolve.dedupe`** pins seven UI libs to one copy: `@radix-ui/react-checkbox`,
  `@radix-ui/react-select`, `@radix-ui/react-slot`, `class-variance-authority`, `clsx`,
  `lucide-react`, `tailwind-merge`. The SDK is `@molcrafts/molvis-plugin@0.2.0`
  from npm (peers, not bundled); local imports of the same UI libs must
  resolve to one copy or two Radix trees break portals and context, not just
  size. Two further pins live in `resolve.alias` via `pinnedEntries`:
  `json5` forced to CJS (its ESM build lacks the named `parse` that `@jupyterlite/services`
  imports) and `tailwind-merge` forced to `dist/bundle-mjs.mjs` (dedupe bypasses its `exports`
  map). A package that cannot be located is **omitted**, never mapped to `false` — `alias: false`
  once silently stubbed `tailwind-merge` out of a bundle that still passed every gate.
- **`sideEffects`** — `false` for root, lammps-input-generator and pyodide-molpy; `["*.css"]` for
  alchemist and carbon-tube-builder, which side-effect-import their own stylesheet. Only lammps
  declares the seven UI libs as `dependencies`; the others reach them through the SDK.
- **Deliberate duplication** — a `src/version.ts` identity module per package (ids, `COMMANDS`,
  storage keys), the documented fix for versions that had drifted across three files; a
  `register<Plugin>(api)` named export in three of four children so meta and standalone entries
  share one registration path (alchemist is the exception); a per-plugin inline token table
  (lammps from the SDK's `token()`, pyodide from its local `ui/theme.ts`); a `styles.d.ts` CSS
  shim in two packages; a `rstest.config.ts` and a `tsconfig.json` per package. Version-scheme
  invariants are enforced by scripts, not types.
- **Uncertain** — `settings/about/register.tsx` in pyodide-molpy is an empty no-op
  (`registerVersionSettings(_api) {}`) that `index.tsx` still calls; the source does not say
  whether it is a stub awaiting content or leftover.

## Peers (never bundle)

`react`, `react-dom`, `react/jsx-runtime`, `@molcrafts/molvis-core`,
`@molcrafts/molrs`, `@molcrafts/molplot` — externalized through the SDK's
`pluginExternals`. Bundling any of them gives the host a second copy and a
second React tree.
